reading.body:
This facility cannot be read. The coordinates provided resolve to a Microsoft data center campus in San Antonio's Westover Hills corridor, not to a Valero-operated property. Valero Energy maintains corporate headquarters in Bexar County, and the research notes consistent with an enterprise data center supporting those operations, but no published capacity figure exists for this facility and no independent source confirms Valero operates a data center at the stated location.

A parcel-level check of Bexar County records would be required to establish whether Valero operates a data center facility anywhere in the county, and if so, where. Without resolved coordinates and published specifications, this entry cannot be ranked against other Texas facilities or assessed for relevance to AI infrastructure.

The classification as unresolvable is correct. Remove this entry from any analysis of AI-relevant data center capacity in Texas until coordinates are verified and a published capacity figure is obtained from Valero or confirmed through independent reporting.
